Frequently Asked Questions

Can I cancel my subscription at any time?

Yes. You can cancel your subscription from your settings dashboard at any time. You will continue to have access to your plan until the end of your billing period.

How does the ATS score scan work?

Our algorithm checks your CV formatting, section titles, headers, and keyword presence against applicant tracking system standards and compares them to your target role to generate recommendations.

Is my personal data secure?

Absolutely. We encrypt all information. Free tier scans are kept strictly in memory, and Pro/Elite documents are securely stored in your personal account.

How do I practice mock interviews?

Simply head over to the Interview Prep page after subscribing, input your resume & target role, and our AI will generate personalized questions and grade your answers.

Secure checkout via Stripe. All data protected under GDPR guidelines.
